title: Pennsylvania Faces Growing Measles Crisis as Deaths Rise
subtitle: State officials and federal agencies disagree on death counts while the virus spreads across dozens of counties.

summary.en: Pennsylvania has recorded its fifth measles-related death as the state struggles with a major outbreak. Over 900 cases have been confirmed across 39 counties, mostly among unvaccinated individuals. The state government is currently in a dispute with federal health agencies regarding how to count these deaths. Experts warn that measles is highly contagious and can cause serious long-term health problems. Public health officials continue to organize vaccination clinics to stop the spread of the virus.
summary.zh: 賓夕法尼亞州在對抗大規模麻疹疫情的同時，記錄了第五起與該病相關的死亡案例。全州三十九個郡已確診超過九百起病例，患者多為未接種疫苗者。州政府目前正與聯邦衛生機構就死亡人數的統計方式產生爭議。專家警告，麻疹傳染力極強，且可能導致嚴重的長期健康問題。公共衛生官員持續組織疫苗接種站，以遏止病毒擴散。

paragraphs.en: Pennsylvania is currently dealing with a serious health crisis as the state reports its fifth measles-associated death of 2026. According to The Guardian Health, the latest victim was an unvaccinated resident of Lancaster County. This brings the total number of confirmed cases in the state to 943, spread across 39 different counties. Since the outbreak began in late April, 176 people have been hospitalized, highlighting the dangerous nature of the disease.
paragraphs.zh: 賓夕法尼亞州目前正深陷嚴重的健康危機，該州通報了二〇二六年第五起與麻疹相關的死亡案例。根據《衛報健康版》（The Guardian Health）報導，最新的一名受害者是蘭開斯特郡（Lancaster County）的一位未接種疫苗居民。這使得該州確診病例總數達到九百四十三例，遍布三十九個郡。自四月下旬疫情爆發以來，已有一百七十六人住院治療，凸顯了這種疾病的危險性。

paragraphs.en: Measles is known as one of the most contagious diseases in medicine. It spreads through the air when an infected person coughs, sneezes, or simply breathes. According to NPR Health, you do not need to touch an infected person to catch the virus; simply being in the same space within two hours of an infected person can lead to sickness. Experts note that one person with measles can infect up to 18 other people if they have not been vaccinated. The MMR vaccine—a shot that protects against measles, mumps, and rubella—is highly effective, preventing 97% of cases.
paragraphs.zh: 麻疹被公認為醫學上最具傳染性的疾病之一。當感染者咳嗽、打噴嚏或僅僅是呼吸時，病毒就會透過空氣傳播。根據美國國家公共廣播電台健康版（NPR Health）的報導，你不需要接觸感染者就會染病；只要在感染者離開後的兩小時內進入同一個空間，就可能導致生病。專家指出，若未接種疫苗，一名麻疹患者最多可傳染給十八個人。麻疹、腮腺炎與德國麻疹混合疫苗（MMR疫苗）是一種能預防這三種疾病的注射劑，效果極佳，可預防百分之九十七的病例。

paragraphs.en: There is currently a disagreement between state and federal officials regarding the death toll. The Pennsylvania Department of Health reports five deaths, but the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has not included these in its national count. The Guardian Health reports that the state even threatened to stop working with the CDC unless the federal agency recognized the deaths reported by Pennsylvania. This tension follows public comments from U.S. health secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., who questioned whether the deaths were truly caused by the measles virus or by other health conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 目前州政府與聯邦官員對於死亡人數的統計存在分歧。賓夕法尼亞州衛生廳通報了五起死亡案例，但美國疾病管制與預防中心（CDC）並未將其納入全國統計數據中。《衛報健康版》報導稱，該州甚至威脅，除非聯邦機構承認賓州通報的死亡人數，否則將停止與疾病管制與預防中心合作。這種緊張關係源於美國衛生部長小羅伯特·甘迺迪（Robert F. Kennedy Jr.）公開質疑這些死亡案例究竟是由麻疹病毒引起，還是由其他健康狀況所致。

paragraphs.en: Dr. Paul Offit, a professor at the University of Pennsylvania, believes the actual number of cases across the country is likely higher than official reports suggest. He explained to NPR Health that many people do not seek medical help when they get sick, meaning they are not counted in official statistics. Dr. Kalyani McCullough of the California Department of Public Health warned that measles is not just a simple fever or rash. She noted that it can have long-lasting effects on the body, including a condition called "immune amnesia," where the virus weakens the body's ability to fight off other future infections.
paragraphs.zh: 賓夕法尼亞大學（University of Pennsylvania）教授保羅·歐菲特（Paul Offit）博士認為，全國實際的病例數很可能高於官方報告的數字。他向美國國家公共廣播電台健康版解釋，許多人在生病時並未尋求醫療協助，這意味著他們未被計入官方統計數據。加州公共衛生廳的卡莉亞妮·麥卡洛（Kalyani McCullough）博士警告，麻疹不僅僅是簡單的發燒或出疹。她指出，麻疹會對身體造成長期影響，包括一種稱為「免疫失憶」的狀況，即病毒會削弱身體抵禦未來其他感染的能力。

paragraphs.en: Agricultural communities in Lancaster and Mifflin counties remain at the center of the outbreak in Pennsylvania. To fight the spread, state health centers have held 180 pop-up vaccination clinics, giving out more than 5,500 doses of the MMR vaccine. Officials plan to hold dozens more clinics in the coming weeks. According to The Guardian Health, less than 1% of the state's total cases have involved people who were already vaccinated, proving that the vaccine remains the best form of protection.
paragraphs.zh: 蘭開斯特郡與米夫林郡（Mifflin County）的農業社區仍是賓州疫情的核心地帶。為了對抗疫情擴散，州衛生中心已舉辦了一百八十場臨時疫苗接種站，施打了超過五千五百劑MMR疫苗。官員計畫在未來幾週內再舉辦數十場接種活動。根據《衛報健康版》報導，該州總病例中，僅有不到百分之一的患者是已經接種過疫苗的人，這證明疫苗仍是最好的保護方式。

paragraphs.en: Nationwide, the situation is also concerning. The CDC reports more than 3,600 cases across the United States this year. While the U.S. was considered to have eliminated measles in 2000, experts are now worried that this status is at risk. Vaccination rates among young children have slowly dropped, which health experts blame on confusion and misinformation regarding vaccines. As cases continue to appear in public places like sports stadiums, trains, and bars, health experts urge the public to stay informed and ensure their vaccinations are up to date.
paragraphs.zh: 在全國範圍內，情況同樣令人擔憂。疾病管制與預防中心報告稱，今年全美已出現超過三千六百起病例。儘管美國在二〇〇〇年被認為已消除麻疹，但專家現在擔心這種狀態正岌岌可危。幼童的疫苗接種率緩慢下降，衛生專家將此歸咎於對疫苗的困惑與錯誤資訊。隨著病例持續出現在體育場、火車與酒吧等公共場所，衛生專家呼籲大眾保持警覺，並確保疫苗接種紀錄更新至最新狀態。

paragraphs.en: For residents, the advice from health professionals is clear: two doses of the MMR vaccine provide strong protection against the virus. As the state continues its response, officials are monitoring the numbers daily to better understand how the virus is moving through communities. While the dispute between state and federal agencies continues, the primary goal for local health workers remains the same: to provide vaccines to those who need them and to stop the further spread of this dangerous, preventable disease.
paragraphs.zh: 對於居民而言，醫療專業人員的建議很明確：接種兩劑MMR疫苗能提供對抗病毒的強大保護力。隨著該州持續應對疫情，官員們正每日監控數據，以更深入了解病毒如何在社區間傳播。儘管州政府與聯邦機構之間的爭議仍在持續，但地方衛生工作者的首要目標始終不變：為有需要的人提供疫苗，並阻止這種危險且可預防的疾病進一步擴散。

quiz.question: According to the article, what is the current status of the vaccination efforts in Pennsylvania?

options.A: Over 5,500 people have been vaccinated at permanent state health facilities.
options.B: Health officials have conducted 180 temporary clinics to administer vaccines.
options.C: Less than 1% of the population has received the MMR vaccine so far.
options.D: The state has stopped all vaccination clinics due to the dispute with the CDC.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章第五段明確指出，為了對抗疫情，州衛生中心已經舉辦了 180 場快閃疫苗接種站（pop-up vaccination clinics），並施打了超過 5,500 劑疫苗。選項 A 錯誤，因為這些是「快閃」站點而非永久設施。選項 C 錯誤，文中提到少於 1% 的病例是發生在已接種疫苗的人身上，而非全州僅 1% 的人接種。選項 D 錯誤，文中提到官員計畫在未來幾週舉辦更多診所，並未停止。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the official national measles statistics reported by the CDC?

options.A: They are likely lower than the actual number of cases occurring in the country.
options.B: They are highly accurate because every sick person seeks professional medical help.
options.C: They include all deaths reported by individual states without any verification.
options.D: They confirm that measles is no longer a threat to the United States.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。根據第四段，Paul Offit 博士解釋許多人患病後並未尋求醫療協助，因此未被計入官方統計，這暗示了官方數據可能低估了實際病例數。選項 B 與文章內容矛盾，因為許多人不尋求醫療協助。選項 C 錯誤，因為第三段明確提到 CDC 並未將賓州報告的死亡人數納入統計，顯示其有審核機制。選項 D 錯誤，文章強調疫情正在擴散，且美國消除麻疹的地位正受到威脅。

quiz.question: In the sixth paragraph, what does the word 'status' mean in the phrase 'experts are now worried that this status is at risk'?

options.A: A person's social or professional rank.
options.B: The current state or condition of something.
options.C: A legal document regarding health records.
options.D: The speed at which a disease spreads.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在此語境中，status 指的是美國在 2000 年獲得的「消除麻疹（eliminated measles）」這一公共衛生狀態或認定。選項 A 指的是個人社會地位，不符合語境。選項 C 並非文中指涉的內容。選項 D 則完全偏離了這個詞的定義，status 描述的是一種既定的狀況，而非傳播速度。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article?

options.A: The measles outbreak in Pennsylvania is being handled perfectly by federal agencies.
options.B: Measles is a minor illness that only affects people in agricultural communities.
options.C: Vaccination is the most effective way to address the serious and spreading threat of measles.
options.D: The disagreement between state and federal officials is the main cause of the measles outbreak.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章整體旨在探討麻疹疫情的嚴重性、傳染力，並強調疫苗（MMR）在預防疾病上的高效性與重要性，無論是提到疫苗的保護力（第二段）還是官方鼓勵民眾接種（最後一段），都圍繞此核心。選項 A 錯誤，因為文中提到州與聯邦有衝突。選項 B 錯誤，文中提到麻疹是極具傳染力的疾病，不限於農業社區。選項 D 錯誤，官員間的爭執是疫情期間的插曲，而非疫情爆發的根本原因。
